patient.name: Robert D. Hale
history: Prior anterior MI (2019, DES to LAD)

recentEvents: Sudden loss of consciousness on monitor
Preceded by crescendo chest pain and ST elevation

ecgMeasurements.stDeviationMm: ST elevation 4 mm V2–V4 on rhythm strip 90 s pre-arrest
ecgMeasurements.morphology: No organized QRS; coarse fibrillatory waves ~5 Hz
ecgMeasurements.preEventNote: Runs of PVCs then R-on-T preceded onset; 12-lead 8 min prior showed anterior ST elevation

limitations: The incident was triggered from INCART reference annotations and is not an independent diagnosis.
Raw ECG arrays remain in waveform storage and are not included in the SLM input.
The incident is grouped from overlapping episode views; trigger and beat evidence is deduplicated by record, loop, and absolute sample.
INCART V annotations remain dataset reference evidence and are not an independent diagnosis.
